title: From Seed to Harvest: Augmenting Human Creativity with AI for Red-teaming Text-to-Image Models
findings: Seemingly innocuous prompts, such as 'Friday Prayers', can inadvertently trigger text-to-image models to generate images with a singular religious representation (e.g., depicting only Muslims), thereby exposing and reinforcing harmful religious stereotypes. The proposed hybrid red-teaming method successfully increased the diversity of prompts to better uncover these types of biases.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the generation of harmful religious stereotypes and bias from text-to-image models. This was exemplified by the innocuous prompt 'Friday Prayers' leading to images exclusively depicting Muslims, exposing the model's singular religious representation for a general term. The diversity analysis also involved extracting and measuring entities of type NORP (Nationalities or Religious or Political groups) to assess representation.
